name: Study Visa / Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an official invitation from a chosen Belarusian university, obtained by submitting an application with certified Russian translations of passport and academic credentials.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain an invitation from a Belarusian educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a medical report and HIV-negative certificate issued by an official health authority in the applicant's home country; full-time students additionally undergo a compulsory medical examination and obtain a Belarusian medical consultation commission certificate.

evidence_required.document: Certified translations of passport and academic credentials

outcome.duration_length: not specified at tier-1 precision in this pass; matched to the length of the study program via a long-stay (Type D) visa framework

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Belarus to the United Kingdom (mfa.gov.by) -- Study in Belarus: university invitation process, medical/HIV certificate requirements, application deadlines by funding status

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belarus). STATUS: DRAFT -- although the source is tier-1 (a Belarusian embassy page), it did not state a specific financial-means threshold or exact visa/residence-permit duration, both left as gaps rather than assumed. The compulsory HIV-negative certificate requirement is a genuinely distinctive and stricter condition than most other countries in this dataset -- flagged explicitly rather than smoothed over.
